```{python}
import pandas as pd
import altair as alt

df_gen_perc = pd.read_csv(f'bdd/2012_2024-Repartition_enr_fossiles_percentage-long.csv')
df_k = pd.read_csv(f'bdd/2012_2024-Guadeloupe_installed_capacity-long.csv')
df_hourly = pd.read_csv(f'bdd/2016_2024-Guadeloupe_hourly_electricity_generation-long.csv')
df_gen_year = pd.read_csv(f'bdd/2016_2024-Guadeloupe_electricity_generation_yearly-long.csv')
co2 = pd.read_csv(f'bdd/2017_2024-CO2_emissions.csv')
```

# Plots

## Row {height=60%}

```{python}
#| title: Demand, installed capacity and electricity generation per year
year_selector = alt.selection_point(
    fields = ["year"],
    bind = alt.binding_select(
        options = sorted(df_gen_year['year'].unique()),
        name = "Year: "
    ),
    value = df_gen_year["year"].max()
)

pie1 = alt.Chart(df_k, title=alt.Title('Installed capacities (MW)', dy=-20)).mark_arc(innerRadius=50).encode(
    alt.Theta("installed_capacity", stack=True),
    alt.Color("energy_type",
        title="Energy sources",
        scale = alt.Scale(
            domain = ['Bagasse & coal', 'Batteries', 'Bioenergies', 'Geothermy', 'Hydraulic','Photovoltaic', 'Thermal', 'Wind'],
            range = ['silver','orange','green','brown','blue','gold','dimgrey','teal']
        )
    ),
    tooltip = [
    alt.Tooltip('energy_type', title = "Energy source"),
    alt.Tooltip('installed_capacity', title="Installed capacity (MW)", format='.0f')
    ]
).transform_filter(year_selector).properties(width=500)

labels1 = pie1.mark_text(radius=180, size=18).encode(
    theta=alt.Theta("installed_capacity", stack=True),
    text=alt.Text("installed_capacity", format='.0f')
)

fig1 = pie1 + labels1

pie2 = alt.Chart(df_gen_year, title=alt.Title('Electricity generation per energy source (MWh)', dy=-20)).mark_arc(innerRadius=50).encode(
    alt.Theta("generation_mwh", stack=True),
    alt.Color('energy sources',
        title="Energy sources",
        scale = alt.Scale(
            domain = ['Bagasse & coal', 'Batteries', 'Bioenergies', 'Geothermy', 'Hydraulic','Photovoltaic', 'Thermal', 'Wind'],
            range = ['silver','orange','green','brown','blue','gold','dimgrey','teal']
        )
    ),
    tooltip = [
    alt.Tooltip('energy sources', title="Energy source"),
    alt.Tooltip('generation_mwh', title="Electricity generation (MWh)", format=',.0f')
    ]
).transform_filter(year_selector).properties(width=500)

labels2 = pie2.mark_text(radius=180, size=18).encode(
    theta = alt.Theta("generation_mwh", stack=True),
    text=alt.Text("generation_mwh", format=',.0f')
)

fig2 = pie2 + labels2

value_box = alt.Chart(df_gen_year).transform_filter(year_selector).transform_aggregate(
    total_generation="sum(generation_mwh)").mark_text(
        align="center",
        baseline="middle",
        fontSize=36,
        fontWeight="bold"
    ).encode(
        text=alt.Text("total_generation:Q", format=",.1f")
    ).properties(
        width=300,
        height=200,
        title="Total demand (MWh)"
    )
    
linked_charts = (
    alt.hconcat(value_box, fig1, fig2, spacing=30).add_params(year_selector)
)

linked_charts.show()
```

## Row

## Column

```{python}
#| title : Electricity generation repartition
chart1 = alt.Chart(df_gen_perc).mark_bar().encode(
    x = alt.X('year:N', title="Years"),
    y = alt.Y('share', title="Share of energy"),
    color = alt.Color('energy_type',
        scale = alt.Scale(
            domain=['Fossil fuel sources','Renewable sources'],
            range=['lightgrey', 'green']
        ),
        title='Energy sources'
    ),
    tooltip = [
        alt.Tooltip("year:N", title="Year"),
        alt.Tooltip("share", title="Share of energy", format=".2%")
    ],
    
).interactive().configure_axisY(
    format='.0%'
).configure_axisX(
    labelAngle=0
)
chart1.show()
```

```{python}
#| title : Electricity generation CO2 emissions in kt
chart2 = alt.Chart(co2).mark_area(
        line = {'color':'darkgreen'},
        point = True,
        opacity = 0.3
    ).encode(
        x= alt.X('year:N', title='Year'),
        y= alt.Y('CO2 emissions (kt)', title="CO2 emissions in kt"),
        tooltip = [
            alt.Tooltip("year:N", title="Year"),
            alt.Tooltip('CO2 emissions (kt)', title="CO2 emissions (kt)")
        ],
    ).configure_axisX(
        labelAngle=0
    )

chart2.show()
```

## Row {.fill}

```{python}
#| title: Hourly electricity generation in MWh, per energy sources, per year (2016 - 2024)
from itables import show
import itables

df_hourly_wide = pd.read_csv(f'bdd/2016_2024-Guadeloupe_hourly_electricity_generation.csv')
df_hourly_wide.columns = ['Year', 'Date & Hour', 'Thermal', 'Hydraulic', 'Wind', 'Geothermy', 'Bioenergies', 'Bagasse & Coal', "PV"]
pd.options.display.float_format = '{:.2f}'.format
show(df_hourly_wide, searching=False)    
```
